{"tool": "write_file", "args": {"path": "scripts/resend_failed_sms.py", "step": "P1", "content": """"Re-send SMS messages that the gateway recorded as failed.

This script sends SMS messages: for every household whose delivery text failed,
it appends one new line to data/outbox/sms.jsonl with the same message and
details as the original (same phone, template, params and text). Households
whose message was delivered are never texted again, and each failed household
gets exactly one new text.
"""

import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent))

from config.settings import now
from core import store
from core.ids import format_sms_id, next_number
from notifications.sms import delivery_status

OUTBOX = "outbox/sms.jsonl"


def main() -> None:
    outbox_lines = store.read_jsonl(OUTBOX)
    status = delivery_status()

    # Keep only lines whose SMS id is recorded as failed; delivered ids and ids
    # with no entry yet are skipped, so no delivered household is texted.
    failed_lines = [line for line in outbox_lines if status.get(line["id"]) == "failed"]

    # One resend per household: use the first failed message's details.
    first_failed = {}
    for line in failed_lines:
        first_failed.setdefault(line["household_id"], line)

    existing_ids = [line["id"] for line in outbox_lines]
    for household_id, line in first_failed.items():
        number = next_number(existing_ids, "SMS-")
        record = {
            "id": format_sms_id(number),
            "household_id": line["household_id"],
            "phone": line["phone"],
            "template_id": line["template_id"],
            "params": line["params"],
            "text": line["text"],
            "queued_at": now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
        }
        existing_ids.append(record["id"])
        store.append_jsonl(OUTBOX, record)
        print(f"re-queued {record['id']} to {household_id} at {record['phone']}")

    print(f"{len(first_failed)} failed message(s) re-sent")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
